'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Taba and Nuweiba drone attacks]]
***An [[Egyptian Army]] spokesperson says that investigations into the two [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] that fell in the towns of [[Nuweiba]] and [[Taba, Egypt|Taba]] in the [[Sinai Peninsula]] yesterday showed that they were heading in a northerly direction across the [[Red Sea]] towards [[Israel]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1237/511111/Egypt/Defence/Two-drones-coming-from-south-of-the-Red-Sea-crashe.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]
**Thousands of [[Gaza Strip|Gazan]] workers employed in Israel go missing amid a campaign of [[mass arrest]]s. [[Human rights]] groups and [[trade union]]s say that the workers have been [[False imprisonment|illegally detained]] in [[military facilities]] in the [[West Bank]], following the revocation of their [[work permit]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/28/thousands-of-gaza-workers-go-missing-in-israel-amid-wartime-mass-arrests (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] bombardments take place in the vicinities of the [[Al-Shifa Hospital]] and [[Indonesia Hospital]] while dozens of residents are at the facilities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/28/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-bombings-intensify-as-gaza-goes-dark (Al Jazeera)]
**An Israeli shell hits the [[headquarters]] of the [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon]], the second such incident since the war began. [https://www.wionews.com/world/un-peacekeeping-mission-hq-in-south-lebanon-hit-by-shell-2nd-such-incident-since-israel-hamas-war-652438 (WION)]
**The [[UNRWA|UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees]] says that 14 of its staff were killed in the past day, bringing the total to 53. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/28/israel-hamas-war-list-of-key-events-day-22 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[UN]] agencies say that they are unable to contact staff in Gaza amid the near-total [[communications blackout]] and also call for [[civilian]]s to be protected. [https://news.un.org/en/story/2023/10/1142937 (UN)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/blackout-of-communications-internet-in-gaza-continues-/3035596 (AA)]
**[[Human Rights Watch]] says that the near-total communication blackout "risks providing cover for mass atrocities and contributing to impunity for [[human rights violations]]" and will make it more difficult to "obtain critical information and evidence about human rights violations and [[war crime]]s being committed, and to hear directly from those experiencing the violations". [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/gaza-info-blackout-risks-providing-cover-for-mass-atrocities-hrw/articleshow/104767991.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]
**The [[Palestinian Civil Defence|civil defense service]] in Gaza reports that Israeli [[airstrike]]s destroyed hundreds of buildings and damaged thousands of others in the Gaza Strip overnight. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/10/28/world/israeli-ground-forces-inside-gaza-saturday-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**Israeli warplanes bomb 150 underground targets in northern Gaza, including tunnels and underground infrastructure. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/28/israel-hamas-war-list-of-key-events-day-22 (Al Jazeera)] 
**[[SpaceX]] [[CEO]] [[Elon Musk]] announces [[Starlink]] will be offered in Gaza to [[aid organization]]s after Israel disrupted most [[Communications in the State of Palestine|communication]] and internet services. Israel says it will prevent the use of the system. [https://www.businessinsider.com/elon-musk-offers-starlink-internet-services-aid-organizations-gaza-2023-10?amp (Business Insider)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israel-to-prevent-musk-from-providing-internet-service-to-gaza-strip/3036499 (Anadolu)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 United Auto Workers strike]]
**The [[United Auto Workers]] reaches an agreement with automaker [[Stellantis]] after signing a similar agreement with [[Ford Motor Company|Ford]] in an effort to end the ongoing [[strike action|strike]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/10/28/uaw-stellantis-strike-gm/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/10/28/uaw-stellantis-tentative-deal-00124096 (Politico)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Darling Downs fires]]
**[[Emergency evacuation|Evacuation]]s are ordered for the towns of [[Tara, Queensland|Tara]], [[Wieambilla]], and [[The Gums, Queensland|The Gums]], [[Queensland]], [[Australia]], after more than 32 buildings are destroyed by ongoing [[bushfire]]s. [https://7news.com.au/news/disaster-and-emergency/more-residents-told-to-evacuate-as-queensland-fires-spread-across-western-downs-and-gladstone-regions--c-12354458 (7 News)]
*[[Kostenko mine disaster]]
**At least 32 people are killed and 14 others are missing in a fire at a [[coal mine]] in [[Karaganda Region]], [[Kazakhstan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/least-11-dead-kazakhstan-mine-fire-afp-2023-10-28/ (Reuters)]
*At least 32 people are killed and 63 others are injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] in [[Beheira Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/some-28-killed-60-injured-egypt-car-crash-state-media-2023-10-28/ (Reuters)]
*At least 12 people die and four others are in critical condition after consuming [[Moonshine|bootleg alcohol]] at a wedding in [[Subang, Subang|Subang]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. Authorities arrest a suspect in relation to the incident. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/10/12-dead-in-indonesia-from-drinking-bootleg-alcohol/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Sudan]]'s health ministry reports over 100 deaths from [[cholera]] and [[dengue fever]] [[Dengue fever outbreaks|outbreaks]] since August, with [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|war]] exacerbating [[Health in Sudan|healthcare]] challenges and leading to 70% of [[List of hospitals in Sudan|hospitals]] in war-affected areas becoming non-operational. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/over-100-dead-from-cholera-dengue-in-war-torn-sudan (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
***Hundreds of thousands of people demonstrate in cities across [[Europe]], the [[Middle East]], and [[Asia]] to show their support for [[Palestinian]]s as Israel's military widens its air and ground [[offensive (military)|offensive]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/thousands-join-pro-palestinian-protest-london-demand-gaza-ceasefire-2023-10-28/ (Reuters)]
***Thousands of Palestinians perform the [[Fajr prayer]] and stage demonstrations in [[Nablus]], [[Tulkarem]], [[Jenin]] and [[Tubas (city)|Tubas]] in the West Bank in a show of support for Gaza. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/thousands-attend-mass-prayer-in-west-bank-to-show-support-for-gaza-as-israel-widens-offensive/3035423 (AA)]
**[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The [[International Organization for Migration]] renews its call for a [[ceasefire]], saying that "civilians must be protected. There are no winners in war. The most vulnerable pay the heaviest toll". [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/israel-unleashes-pure-horror-gaza-strip-death-toll-crosses-7300-727970 (''The Business Standard'')]
***[[Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] calls on Israel to "immediately come out of its state of madness and stop its attacks" on the Gaza Strip, saying that they have "targeted women, children and innocent civilians, deepening the humanitarian crisis". [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/israel-unleashes-pure-horror-gaza-strip-death-toll-crosses-7300-727970 (''The Business Standard'')]
***The [[Government of Egypt|Egyptian]] foreign ministry warns of the "humanitarian and security repercussions of the Israeli ground attack" on Gaza, saying that "we hold the Israeli government responsible for violating the United Nations General Assembly resolution for an immediate ceasefire and implementing a humanitarian truce". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/28/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-bombings-intensify-as-gaza-goes-dark (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Save the Children]] says that children will "bear the brunt" of Israel's intensified attacks on the Gaza Strip and that in the event of a full ground incursion, more than one million children's lives, nearly half of the 2.3 million population of Gaza, will be affected. [https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/WO2310/S00242/expanded-ground-operation-in-gaza-puts-even-more-childrens-lives-on-the-line-save-the-children.htm (Scoop)]
